contract.selector: PBR_ALLTYPE with explicit VariableArchives, optional TeachPrograms for variable-only graphs
contract.graph: Union of supplied edges, cycles/shared nodes, known macro exclusion and bounded bridge persistence
contract.manifest: Root.PB, karel2py-program-batch-v1, canonical membership/graph and SHA-256 hashes over existing portable TP/VR members
contract.preflight: Complete file/quota/garbage, destination schema/alias/task/timer/output/protection and capacity validation before either store changes
contract.restore: Manifest snapshot membership; validate all members, retain existing TP records/current graphs, overwrite compatible VR values and retain unlisted roots
contract.clear: Remove selected TP records, reset owned VR values, preserve code/declarations/resources/aliases
contract.effects: ALLTYPE clear and all PROG_RESTORE forms count as possible variable writes for direct/transitive/handler FOR guards

choices.choice: Combined minimum byte budget includes manifest; whole-batch atomic preflight instead of native partial progress
Manifest snapshot defines members; no directory scan or implicit executable loading; absent manifest allows old TP branch except explicit PB request
Reset owned variables without deleting namespaces or unloading KAREL source

boundaries: Portable TP/VR/PB JSON, not native binaries or storage layouts
Hashes bind exact member bytes, not origin/authenticity
Protection omissions can leave a deliberately incomplete unrestorable batch
No crash journal, native concurrency/retry/partial progress, physical storage or controller/strict equivalence
